purpose: Fetch verified evidence for a term
query: MATCH (t:Core {id:$term})-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(e:Evidence)-[r:CITED_FROM]->(d:Core) WHERE e.status = 'verified' RETURN e.id AS evidence_id, e.payload AS evidence, d.id AS doc, r.line AS line ORDER BY e.id LIMIT 12

purpose: Terms citing a changed source; structural impact only
query: MATCH (t:Core)-[r:CITES]->(d:Core {id:$doc}) RETURN t.id AS term, r.via AS via ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 30

purpose: Existing conflict records involving a term
query: MATCH (c:Core)-[r:CONTESTS]->(t:Core {id:$term}) RETURN c.id AS record, c.payload AS detail, r.via AS via ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 12

purpose: Existing questions raised by a term
query: MATCH (q:Core)-[r:RAISED_BY]->(t:Core {id:$term}) RETURN q.id AS question, q.payload AS detail, r.via AS via ORDER BY q.id LIMIT 12

purpose: Two terms citing the same document; no inferred relationship
query: MATCH (a:Core {id:$left})-[ra:READS]->(d:Core)<-[rb:READS]-(b:Core {id:$right}) RETURN d.id AS doc, ra.via AS left_via, rb.via AS right_via ORDER BY d.id LIMIT 12

purpose: Unread source candidates for a registered question
query: MATCH (q:SearchQuery {id:$query})-[r:P_RETRIEVED]->(h:Hit)-[:AT_DOC]->(d:Core) WHERE d.read_status = 'unread' AND h.freshness = 'current' RETURN d.id AS doc, h.first_line AS first_line, h.last_line AS last_line, r.method AS method, r.rank AS rank ORDER BY r.rank LIMIT 8

purpose: Ranked reading candidates for one decision sheet
query: MATCH (s:Sheet {id:$sheet})-[:HAS_QUERY]->(q:SearchQuery)-[r:P_RETRIEVED]->(h:Hit)-[:AT_DOC]->(d:Core) RETURN q.text AS query, d.id AS doc, h.first_line AS line, h.freshness AS freshness, r.method AS method, r.rank AS rank ORDER BY r.rank LIMIT 12

purpose: Explicit prerequisites, never automatic decision ordering
query: MATCH (s:Sheet {id:$sheet})-[r:DEPENDS_ON]->(b:Sheet) RETURN b.id AS prerequisite, b.status AS status, r.via AS via ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 20

purpose: Attributed source-specific relation candidates for review
query: MATCH (c:Claim)-[:SUBJECT]->(s:Core {id:$term}), (c)-[:OBJECT]->(o:Core), (c)-[:CITED_FROM]->(d:Core) WHERE c.quote_status = 'placed' RETURN c.id AS claim, c.predicate AS predicate, o.id AS object, c.quote AS quote, d.id AS doc, c.line AS line, c.review_status AS review_status ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 12

purpose: Command for a skill, as explicitly declared by a maintained registry
query: MATCH (s:Skill {id:$skill})-[r:USES_COMMAND]->(c:Command) RETURN c.invocation AS invocation, r.via AS via ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 10

purpose: Decision sheets whose recorded search hit a changed document
query: MATCH (s:Sheet)-[:HAS_QUERY]->(q:SearchQuery)-[:P_RETRIEVED]->(h:Hit)-[:AT_DOC]->(d:Core {id:$doc}) RETURN DISTINCT s.id AS sheet, q.id AS query ORDER BY s.id LIMIT 20

purpose: Which retrieval run produced a hit, with query and snapshot
query: MATCH (run:SearchRun)-[:RAN]->(q:SearchQuery {id:$query})-[r:P_RETRIEVED]->(h:Hit) RETURN run.id AS run, run.snapshot_hash AS snapshot_hash, q.text AS query, h.id AS hit, r.method AS method, r.rank AS rank ORDER BY r.rank LIMIT 12
